last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 fresh temporomandibular-disorder self-management topics, all classified as non-prescription candidates. The final query set returned 120 unique PubMed PMIDs, 120 article IDs requested, 120 fetched article records, and 120 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects were verified for PMID records: 39788575, 39058437, 40254868, 20937428, 16495014, 23446073, 41135079, 41592474, 39827051, 38710498, 38750518, 40859519, 31665507, 39195117, 32246680, 38923288, 40129425, 33977737, 41370499, 38281850, 36510949, 37877129, 33048053, 31905097, and 38353484. Twenty-five PubMed references were added across 25 new entries. New entries cover neck exercise, PNF and hamstring stretching, postural reeducation, cognitive behavioral therapy, biofeedback, digital therapy, multimodal behavioral therapy, pain neuroscience education, acupuncture, massage with post-isometric relaxation, myofascial release, cervico-mandibular manual therapy, transcutaneous electrostimulation, low-level laser versus TENS, ultrasound, occlusal splint comparisons, dry needling, face yoga, vitamin D, qigong, internet multimodal pain management, cervical manipulation, and additional education. Manual therapy and low-level laser topics were linked to existing temporomandibular-disorder entries. Mindfulness, sleep intervention, acupressure, heat therapy, cold therapy, and omega-3 topics were screened out because the selected PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control magnitude or valid relative effect.
